ncertReference.book: CUET General Test / General Knowledge & Current Affairs Compendium
ncertReference.chapter: Section 1: National Schemes, International Summits & Global Indices

thirtySecondSummary: Current Affairs in CUET evaluates major national initiatives, multilateral summits (G20, BRICS, SCO, ASEAN, COP), international rankings, and key institutional leadership.
National Initiatives: High focus on flagship missions like PM Gati Shakti, Digital India, Chandrayaan/Aditya-L1 missions, National Education Policy (NEP 2020), and green hydrogen targets.
Global Summits: Host nations, themes, new member admissions (e.g., African Union in G20, new members in BRICS+), and climate conference declarations (COP28 UAE consensus).
Global Indices: Rank of India in Human Development Index (UNDP), Global Innovation Index (WIPO), Global Hunger Index, and World Press Freedom Index.
Key Tip: Focus on milestones from the past 12-18 months with exact acronyms, venues, presiding chairs, and bilateral exercise names.

coreConcepts.title: Multilateral Alliances and Summits (G20, BRICS, SCO, Quad)
coreConcepts.explanation:
Multilateral institutions structure modern global governance and form a major question pool in CUET:
1. G20 (Group of Twenty): India held the presidency in 2023 under the theme 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam - One Earth, One Family, One Future'. The historic New Delhi Leaders' Declaration granted permanent membership to the African Union (55 nations). Brazil holds presidency in 2024, followed by South Africa in 2025.
2. BRICS Expansion: Originally Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa. Expanded at the 15th Summit in Johannesburg (2023) to include Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and UAE.
3. SCO (Shanghai Cooperation Organisation): Founded in 2001; permanent members include India, Pakistan, China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and recently Iran and Belarus.
4. Quad (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue): Australia, India, Japan, and the United States working on maritime security, critical technology, and Indo-Pacific stability.
keyTakeaways: G20 2023: New Delhi; African Union added as permanent member.
BRICS expansion: Admitted Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and UAE.
Quad: India, USA, Japan, Australia focusing on free and open Indo-Pacific.
coreConcepts.ncertPointer: CUET General Knowledge Compendium, Global Summits, pp. 6-18.

coreConcepts.title: National Flagship Schemes and Transformational Projects
coreConcepts.explanation:
India's policy landscape emphasizes infrastructure integration, digital public infrastructure (DPI), and social empowerment:
1. PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan: Integrated multi-modal connectivity platform coordinating 16 ministries (railways, highways, ports, telecom) for seamless logistics.
2. Digital Public Infrastructure: The India Stack comprising Aadhaar, UPI (Unified Payments Interface), and DigiLocker has set global benchmarks in financial inclusion.
3. Space Missions: ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 achieved soft landing at lunar south pole (Shiv Shakti Point) on August 23 (National Space Day); Aditya-L1 placed at Lagrange Point 1 to study the solar corona.
4. National Education Policy 2020: Replaces the 10+2 system with the 5+3+3+4 pedagogical structure aiming for 50% Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in higher education by 2035.
keyTakeaways: National Space Day: August 23 (commemorating Chandrayaan-3 landing).
5+3+3+4: Foundational (3-8 yrs), Preparatory (8-11 yrs), Middle (11-14 yrs), Secondary (14-18 yrs).
PM Gati Shakti: Multi-modal logistics coordination framework.
coreConcepts.ncertPointer: India Year Book / Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, pp. 22-45.

coreConcepts.title: Global Indices, International Organizations & Nobel Laureates
coreConcepts.explanation:
International benchmarks and recognition frequently asked in CUET General Test:
1. Human Development Index (HDI): Published by UNDP; calculated based on three dimensions: Life Expectancy, Education (Mean and Expected years of schooling), and Gross National Income (GNI) per capita.
2. Global Innovation Index (GII): Published by World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO); India has climbed consistently into top 40.
3. Climate Summits (UNFCCC COPs): COP28 in Dubai operationalized the Loss and Damage Fund and agreed to transition away from fossil fuels.
4. Nobel Prizes: Awarded annually in Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences (Sveriges Riksbank Prize).
keyTakeaways: HDI 3 dimensions: Health (life expectancy), Education (schooling years), Standard of living (GNI per capita).
WIPO publishes the Global Innovation Index.
UNFCCC COP28: Operationalized Loss and Damage Fund in Dubai.
coreConcepts.ncertPointer: CUET General Test Annual Review, International Reports, pp. 48-64.

workedExamples.question: Which regional organization was officially inducted as a permanent member of the G20 during the 18th G20 Heads of State and Government Summit held in New Delhi in September 2023?

options.text: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)

solutionStepByStep: Step 1: Recall the historic expansion during the 2023 New Delhi G20 Leaders' Summit hosted under India's presidency.
Step 2: Prime Minister Narendra Modi formally announced and invited the 55-member African Union (AU), represented by Comoros President Azali Assoumani, to assume its seat as a permanent member.
Step 3: This marked the first expansion of the G20 since its creation, placing the African Union alongside the European Union as the second institutional continental bloc in the grouping.
workedExamples.cuetInsight: CUET tests recent diplomatic milestones. Always verify the exact name of the head of the organization and the host country.

workedExamples.question:
Consider the following dimensions:
1. Life expectancy at birth
2. Expected and Mean years of schooling
3. Gross National Income (GNI) per capita
Which international index published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) combines these three dimensions into a geometric mean composite index?
solutionStepByStep: Step 1: Review the composite metrics developed by Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen for the UNDP.

Step 2: The Human Development Index (HDI) measures average achievement across three fundamental dimensions: a long and healthy life (life expectancy), knowledge (mean and expected years of schooling), and a decent standard of living (GNI per capita based on PPP).
Step 3: Conclude that option C correctly corresponds to the specified dimensions.
workedExamples.cuetInsight: Multi-statement identification of UN indices is a classic CUET pattern. Know the publishing agency (UNDP, WIPO, WEF).

commonTraps.trap: Confusing publishing agencies of global indices
commonTraps.whyStudentsFail: Attributing the Global Innovation Index to UNDP rather than WIPO, or Human Development Index to World Bank instead of UNDP.
commonTraps.howToAvoid: Create a two-column index matrix: Index Name <-> Publishing Agency.

commonTraps.trap: Overlooking the new pedagogical structure in NEP 2020
commonTraps.whyStudentsFail: Marking 5+3+4+4 or confusing the age breakdown in the 5+3+3+4 framework.
commonTraps.howToAvoid: Remember the foundational 5 covers nursery (3 yrs) + Class 1-2 (2 yrs), totaling 5 years.

practiceQuestions.question: What was the official Sanskrit motto of India's G20 Presidency in 2023?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The official motto of India's 2023 G20 Presidency was 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam' (One Earth, One Family, One Future), drawn from the ancient Maha Upanishad.

practiceQuestions.question: The landing point of the Chandrayaan-3 lander (Vikram) near the south pole of the Moon has been officially designated as:
practiceQuestions.explanation: The touchdown spot of Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander on August 23, 2023, was named 'Shiv Shakti Point'. The crash site of Chandrayaan-2's impact was named 'Tiranga Point'.

practiceQuestions.question: Which organization publishes the annual Human Development Report containing the Human Development Index (HDI)?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Human Development Index (HDI) has been published annually by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) since 1990.

practiceQuestions.question: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, the foundational stage of the 5+3+3+4 structure covers which age bracket?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The foundational stage spans 5 years: 3 years of preschool/Anganwadi (ages 3-6) plus 2 years of primary school Classes 1 & 2 (ages 6-8).

practiceQuestions.question:
Assertion (A): August 23 has been declared as National Space Day in India.
Reason (R): On August 23, 2023, India became the first country to soft-land a spacecraft near the lunar south polar region.

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)

practiceQuestions.explanation: Both statements are historically accurate and (R) provides the exact reason why the Union Cabinet officially designated August 23 as National Space Day.

practiceQuestions.question:
Match List-I (Global Index) with List-II (Publishing Body):
(P) Global Innovation Index — 1. WIPO
(Q) Global Gender Gap Index — 2. World Economic Forum
(R) World Happiness Report — 3. UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network
(S) Human Development Index — 4. UNDP
practiceQuestions.explanation: WIPO publishes the Global Innovation Index, WEF publishes the Global Gender Gap Index, SDSN publishes the World Happiness Report, and UNDP compiles the HDI.

practiceQuestions.question: Which country hosted the United Nations Climate Change Conference COP28 in December 2023 where the Loss and Damage Fund was operationalized?
practiceQuestions.explanation: COP28 took place in Expo City, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, resulting in the UAE Consensus and early operationalization of the Loss and Damage Fund.

practiceQuestions.question: Which of the following nations is NOT one of the members admitted to BRICS during its historic expansion announced in 2023?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The countries joining BRICS in the 2023 expansion included Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the UAE. Singapore is not a member of BRICS.

practiceQuestions.question: What is the targeted Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in higher education by 2035 envisioned under the National Education Policy 2020?
practiceQuestions.explanation: NEP 2020 aims to increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in higher education including vocational education from 26.3% (2018) to 50% by 2035.

practiceQuestions.question:
Assertion (A): PM Gati Shakti is a digital platform designed to bring 16 infrastructure-related ministries together.
Reason (R): Integrated multi-modal planning eliminates departmental silos and reduces logistics costs in India.

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)

practiceQuestions.explanation: PM Gati Shakti coordinates multi-modal infrastructure projects to streamline execution, lower freight transit times, and reduce national logistics costs.
